To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

environmental uncertainty accompanying purchasing in the B2 B market is recognized by enterprises as an important factor influencing the purchase process and it is more often identified by enterprises manufacturing or distributing metal goods in the domestic and international markets than other types of enterprises in the national market.

1) environmental uncertainties accompanying the purchase are recognized by the respondents, 2) they are more frequently recognized by companies manufacturing or distributing metals, 3) they are more often identified in the international market, 4) the scope of supply affects the level of recognition of environmental uncertainties accompanying purchases.
the purchasing uncertainty accompanying B2B transactions is a significant issue for companies operating in Poland.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of environmental uncertainties in the purchasing processes of B2B companies.
the identification of the most significant types of purchasing uncertainty and the analysis of the differences between the national and the international market in this context.
the environmental uncertainties accompanying the B2B purchases in terms of different types of industries and the scope supply chain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the environmental uncertainty accompanying purchases has a negative impact on the purchasing process in general.
purchasing uncertainty accompanying purchases in B2B market is recognized by companies and it is more often identified by enterprises manufacturing or distributing metal goods.

the environmental uncertainties accompanying purchases in the international markets are more frequent than in the national market and they are more often identified by enterprises manufacturing or distributing metal goods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the environmental uncertainties accompany purchasing in the B2C and B2B market but in different ways.
environmental uncertainty is a very important issue in purchasing, especially in the international market.
environmental uncertainties are a significant factor influencing purchasing in the B2C market and that their importance is even greater in the B2 B market.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the purchasing function should not be treated as the same in all industries, especially when it comes to the scope of supply chains.
the purchasing uncertainty is a significant problem of the B2B sector, which requires a special attention of the managers.
the environmental uncertainty in the purchasing process is a significant factor in the purchasing process.
